main_text.p: ἀνάξ, ἀνακτος, rex, ὦ ἀνα & ἀνάξ.
ἡ μονὰς, μονάδος, unitas. sic ὁ χὴ ἡ Φυγὰς exul.
7. χὸς: quæ á fine ξ feré masculina sunt: ut
ὁ βλάξ mollis. Excipe sequentia fœminina:
μάσταξ mandibula, esca: at μύσταξ barba superioris labri, masc.
κλιμαξ clivus arduus. His adde σάρξ caro. Communia sunt ὀμφαξ uva immatura & acerba.

page.notes: Marginal notes at right are small Greek references (e.g. "ακτος", "ὰδος", "ακος") and are only partly legible; the Greek accents and breathings are approximate in this transcription and should be checked against the scan.
